h1: Photo Booth Hire Kettering, Rothwell and Burton Latimer
intro: Planning photo booth hire in Kettering means thinking about a mix of rooms: golf club lounges, school halls, sports club bars and the odd barn on a farm track. Our team handles all of them, arriving early with a trained attendant, a box of props and a print design made around your names, logo or theme. Packages from £239, with delivery, setup and pack-down built in.

sections.heading: Kettering, Rothwell, Desborough and the north of the county
paragraphs: Kettering sits in the north of Northamptonshire, and our bookings here rarely stop at the town boundary. Barton Seagrave on the edge of town, Burton Latimer to the south-east and Rothwell and Desborough further up the A6 are all familiar ground for our attendants. Corby is a short drive away along the A43, and Wellingborough is just down the A509, so a party in either town is no more complicated than one in the town centre.

If your venue sits in a village between these places, tell us the postcode when you enquire and we will confirm the route, the arrival time and the best door to use. Kettering station on the Midland Main Line also makes the town an easy trip for guests travelling in by train, which helps when family are coming from further afield.

sections.heading: Golf clubs, sports clubs and the village hall circuit
paragraphs: Most of the Kettering events we cover happen in a handful of venue types. Hotels in and around the town take the bigger weddings and the office Christmas parties. Golf clubs are a natural home for anniversary dinners, 40th and 50th birthdays and smaller weddings, and sports club function rooms host presentation nights, christenings and end-of-season parties. School halls are where proms and leavers' discos often end up, and community centres look after children's parties and fundraisers.

Away from town, village halls and converted barns bring a more homemade feel, with couples dressing the room themselves and the booth acting as both entertainment and wedding favour. These rooms vary a great deal in size, power and access, so we ask a few questions about each one before recommending a booth.

sections.heading: A14 arrivals, car parks and a one-socket build
paragraphs: The A14 runs right past Kettering, which makes the drive in straightforward, and the A6, A43 and A509 carry us out to the surrounding towns. Almost every venue here has its own car park, so we unload at the nearest door and then move the vehicle out of the way. If the function room is upstairs, let us know whether there is a lift; the slim booths carry easily, but the larger ones prefer a ground-floor room.

Our attendant starts the build roughly an hour before your hire begins. It takes 45 to 60 minutes and none of that time comes out of your hire. Each booth needs a single standard socket, apart from the Inflatable Booth, which needs two. Village halls often release the keys at a set time, so check the hall will be open early, and for barns send a photo of the power points so we can plan the cable run.

Floor level, and whether a lift is available
Socket position, especially in barns and older halls
The time the hall or barn opens for setup

sections.heading: Kettering bookings by booth
paragraphs: The Party Booth is a strong choice for proms in school halls and birthdays at sports clubs, because the curtain and wood panelling give up to eight friends a private space to be as silly as they like. In village halls, the Retro Pod earns its place with a compact 1.5 metre square footprint and an inbuilt printer that keeps cables to a minimum.

Hotel weddings tend to lean towards the Selfie Mirror Pod, with its oval LED frame and instant prints for each guest, while the LCD SlimPod is the sensible all-rounder for community centre parties and budgets that need to stretch. Its smart background removal swaps the backdrop without a green screen.

sections.heading: Advice for Kettering weddings, proms and work parties
paragraphs: For a wedding, open the booth once the speeches are done and place it close to the bar rather than beside the dance floor speakers, so the attendant can be heard. A guest book on the print booths gives you a keepsake to take home. Proms run to tight schedules, so agree the finish time with the school and send the crest for the print template well before the night.

Corporate clients usually want their logo on every print or overlay and digital copies sent by email the same evening. Birthdays suit a themed template and props chosen around the decade or hobby being celebrated. Christmas parties in Kettering hotels and golf clubs fill the December diary quickly, so we suggest booking once the venue is confirmed. We are rated 5 stars on Trustpilot and carry public liability insurance on every job.

faqs.q: Where will you park and unload at a Kettering venue?
faqs.a: Hotels, golf clubs and sports clubs around Kettering nearly all have on-site parking, so we pull up near the entrance, carry the kit in and then park somewhere out of the way. If your venue has a separate delivery door or a narrow lane, mention it when you book and we will plan around it.

faqs.q: What if the function room is up a flight of stairs?
faqs.a: Tell us when you enquire. The LCD SlimPod, GIF Booth and Retro Pod are easy for two people to carry upstairs. The Magic Mirror, Party Booth and Inflatable Booth work best on the ground floor or where a lift is available, and we will suggest the right fit for your room.

faqs.q: Do you add a travel fee for Kettering and the nearby towns?
faqs.a: Delivery and setup are included; if any travel contribution ever applies to a far-flung venue it is shown on the quote up front. Kettering, Burton Latimer, Rothwell, Desborough, Corby and Wellingborough all sit comfortably within the area we cover from day to day.

faqs.q: Our village hall only opens an hour before the party. Is that enough time?
faqs.a: Usually it is, because the build takes 45 to 60 minutes. It helps to ask the hall committee whether we can have access a little earlier, as that leaves room for testing prints and checking the template. If the timing is tight, tell us and we will plan the setup order around it.

faqs.q: Can guests take their photos home on the night as well as by email?
faqs.a: Yes. On print booths every session produces prints on the spot, and digital copies are sent by email with social sharing available. If you choose the GIF Booth, everything is digital, with GIFs, boomerangs and stills delivered instantly by email or QR code.
